review.summary: Fifth host exit 247: the two verified retained steps were skipped, the Python coverage gate and both prerequisite cargo builds exited 0, then flutter test --coverage stalled. 194 of 363 suites loaded and 1593 tests passed in ~140 seconds, after which every suite load froze ~2.5h; stderr records ProcessException: Too many open files spawning per-suite dart development-service children, three late suites failed to load, and the process was SIGKILLed (-9, propagated as gate exit 247). Five orphaned idle flutter_tester loaders from the failed run were disposed.
